career_ladder.note: Assistant Engineers (AE) in Haryana Power Utilities (HVPNL, UHBVNL, DHBVNL, and HPGCL) represent the premier Group A technical engineering executive cadre. Promotions are governed by the Haryana Power Utilities Engineering Service Regulations.

steps.designation: Assistant Engineer (AE - Electrical / Mechanical / Civil / IT)
steps.source_label: Haryana Power Utilities Joint Recruitment Notification for Assistant Engineers & Haryana Civil Services Rules

steps.years: approx. 5-8 yrs (subject to Departmental Accounts Examination for Engineers)
steps.source_label: HPUs Engineering Service Cadre & Promotion Regulations
Haryana Power Utilities Executive Cadre Rules
Haryana Power Utilities Senior Management Regulations
Haryana Power Utilities Top Management Selection Rules

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Assistant Engineers across Haryana Power Utilities is conducted centrally via HVPNL based on normalized Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) scores followed by socio-economic/experience scrutiny and document verification.

stages.stage_name: National GATE Examination (Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering)
stages.source_label: HPUs Joint Recruitment Advertisement & Selection Criteria

papers.paper_name: GATE Paper in Respective Engineering Discipline (Electrical Engineering EE / Civil Engineering CE / Mechanical Engineering ME / Computer Science CS)
papers.negative_marking: -0.33 for 1-mark MCQs; -0.67 for 2-mark MCQs; no negative marking for NAT/MSQ
papers.qualifying_threshold: Valid GATE qualifying score in respective engineering stream

stages.source_label: HPUs Final Selection Criteria (GATE normalized marks + verification)

papers.paper_name: Scrutiny of Engineering Credentials, Biometric Verification, and Reservation/Socio-economic Verification
papers.qualifying_threshold: Verification of full-time B.E./B.Tech degree (min. 60% marks) and Hindi/Sanskrit up to Matric

financial_package.note: Assistant Engineers in Haryana Power Utilities are remunerated at Functional Pay Level 9 (FPL-9) under the Haryana Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016, with entry basic pay of ₹53,100.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Haryana Power Utilities Recruitment Notice & Revised Pay Matrix Level 9 (₹53,100 – ₹1,67,800)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on entry Level 9 basic pay of ₹53,100 with 58% Dearness Allowance (₹30,798), House Rent Allowance (8% to 24% depending on location, e.g. Gurugram/Panchkula/Faridabad at 24% = ₹12,744), power utility technical allowance, and medical reimbursement, minus standard NPS contributions.
official_perks: House Rent Allowance (HRA) or utility executive residential township colony housing
Subsidized electricity allowance as per Haryana Power Utilities policy
Cashless Medical Scheme and medical reimbursement for self and dependents
Defined Contributory Pension Scheme (NPS) with employer contribution
Vehicle conveyance / petrol reimbursement for field and substation inspections

competition_benchmarks.note: Recruitment to Assistant Engineer cadres across Haryana Power Utilities is highly competitive among top-percentile GATE engineering graduates.

years.source_label: HVPNL Advt. Ref. Rectt./HPUs/GATE/2022-2025 — 285 Assistant Engineer posts across HVPNL/HPGCL/UHBVNL/DHBVNL (Electrical 211, Mechanical 55, Civil 19), GATE-score based. Owner-verified against screenshot, 2026-09-19.
HPUs Joint Recruitment 2023-2024: 143 Assistant Engineer posts across HVPNL, UHBVNL, DHBVNL, and HPGCL; over 8,500 GATE-qualified applicants.
